title: Legacy of Ten Thousand Years
next_chapter_hook: The moment the voice fell, Chen Ji's brow center jerked violently—he clearly felt the seal that had slumbered within him for seventeen years loosen by a crack at this instant.

text.content: Golden-red intertwined runes疯狂跳跃 in the void, the scorching temperature burning a scorch mark into Chen Ji's palm. He clenched his teeth, the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea trembling violently, as if a beast that had潜伏for ten thousand years was being awakened by some force. "This reaction..." He narrowed his eyes, his left hand secretly forming seals, the Heavenly Eye pattern悄然浮现 in the depths of his pupils. The Demonic Path commander stood just thirty zhang away, demonic qi surging around him like a tide, yet there was no attack—his posture resembled that of waiting.

Heavenly Eye Activate! Chen Ji's eyes flashed with brilliance,穿透层层魔雾 toward the blurry figure. In the next instant, his pupils contracted sharply—the commander actually housed a Heavenly Fate power of the same source as the Tianji Record, like twin flames, one bright one dark, responding to each other. What was even more bizarre—the core of that power was赫然是一枚符文残片 identical to the mark on Chen Ji's chest.

dialogue.content: "How much can your Heavenly Eye see?" The Demonic Path commander's voice was deep as an abyss, "Do you see that you and I were born of the same origin? Or do you see—the thing hidden within you that even you dare not touch?"

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, yet his heart掀起惊涛骇浪. Born of the same origin? Something within him he didn't know about? He rapidly operated the Tianji Record Fragment, attempting to deduce the truth of these words. However, the Fragment's answer was extremely vague, as if concealed by some force. The Demonic Path commander seemed to see through his thoughts and嗤笑一声: "Don't waste effort. Without my blood pulse resonance, your Fragment can never see through me."

dialogue.content: "Ten thousand years ago, there was a man named Cang Yutian," the commander suddenly spoke, his voice carrying an emotion Chen Ji had never anticipated—hatred, deep-rooted hatred that penetrated the marrow, "He and I were sworn brothers, sharing Heavenly Fate. However, at the moment of ascension, to monopolize the heaven's fortune, he personally pushed me into this endless Void."

text.content: Chen Ji listened quietly, his face serene, yet his mind was疯狂盘算. Cang Yutian—he had seen this name several times in the margins of the Tianji Record Fragment but never investigated deeply. Now it seemed this person was a枭雄 of ancient times who betrayed his fellow practitioners. He looked up at the Demonic Path commander, though unable to see his face clearly, that压抑万年的怨气 was almost condensing into substance.

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path commander's words echoed in his ears, the Tianji Record Fragment faintly scorching. Chen Ji needed to decide how to respond to this feud from ten thousand years ago.

choices.description: Reveal nothing, secretly extract more information to judge whether the other is friend or foe.
choices.risk_hint: If the other party's城府 is deeper, may be反过来算计

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his expression淡漠如常: "The grievances of ten thousand years ago—what have they to do with me? Sir specially appeared, surely not just to tell stories to a Tianqing Sect servant disciple." His voice was unhurried, each word like measuring the other party's bottom line.

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path commander沉默片刻, then suddenly burst out laughing: "Good, 'what have they to do with me'! Chen Xuan had that same attitude back then too, but unfortunately before his death he finally understood—the one chosen by the Tianji Record has never been an 'outsider to the game.'"

choices.text: Showing weakness to lure the enemy into exposing himself
choices.description: Pretend to be intimidated by the other party's momentum, revealing flaws to induce their contempt.
choices.visible_reward: Make the other party lower their guard
choices.risk_hint: If the other party's strength far exceeds imagination, may弄巧成拙

text.content: Chen Ji's brow center微蹙, his figure not visibly retreated half a step,恰好让 Heavenly Eye patterns dim. He lowered his eyes and said softly: "Since the senior knows the Tianji Record, surely you also understand—I am merely a Fragment holder whose life hangs by a thread." His tone was humble, yet寒光一闪而过 in his eyes.

dialogue.content: "Fragment holder?" The Demonic Path commander嗤笑, "You think I would believe that? The Tianji Record never chooses mediocre people. It chose you, because within you there is—" The voice paused, as if considering how much to reveal, "Forget it. Discover it yourself."

choices.description: Stop concealing, fully release the Tianji Record's aura, confront the other party with momentum head-on.
choices.visible_reward: May intimidate the other party in exchange for equal dialogue
choices.risk_hint: If the other party was早已准备, may be targeted

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze骤冷, his palm forcefully发力. The Tianji Record Fragment exploded outward, golden runes rising like angry dragons, pushing back the surrounding demonic mist by several zhang. He stepped forward, his momentum changing dramatically: "I don't care about matters ten thousand years ago. But if you want to use me—" He raised his hand, runes condensing into a sword shape at his fingertips, "Let's see if the price is sufficient."

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path commander's eyes flashed with surprise, then actually revealed a genuine smile: "Interesting. Cang Yutian back then wasn't as good as you—he could only pretend not to see. You are... more worthy of this Fragment."

text.content: Before the words finished, the Demonic Path commander slowly raised his hand, brushing aside the demonic mist. Chen Ji finally saw that face—it was a face almost unrecognizable from erosion by time and hatred, the corners of eyes, lips, and brow center covered密密麻麻 with black cracks. And deep within those cracks,隐约可见 traces of golden old scars, like marks repeatedly cut by blades and repeatedly healed.

Those were the wounds of heaven's counterattack. Chen Ji's pupils微缩. The Tianji Record Fragment contained records—those who act against heaven will surely receive heaven's mark. What Cang Yutian did to him at the moment of ascension was essentially handing heaven's blade and stabbing it into his body. For ten thousand years, he lived trapped in this夹缝 between heaven and earth, covered in wounds.

dialogue.content: "Do you see clearly now?" The Demonic Path commander's voice held no anger, only a平静 after experiencing the vicissitudes of life, "This is the price of betrayal. I should have scattered into nothing, yet I survived on a single执念. Do you know what supported me through these ten thousand years?"

text.content: Chen Ji gave no answer. He stared at those golden scars, suddenly noticing a detail—every scar's position corresponded perfectly with the missing runes on the Tianji Record Fragment. In other words, Cang Yutian back then wasn't simply betraying, but... using some method to剥离 the Tianji Record's components from the Demonic Path commander?

choice.prompt: Chen Ji deduced an astonishing truth from the scar positions. He needed to decide his next response.

choices.text: Following the clues to dig deeper into the truth
choices.description: Follow the discovered clues to interrogate, clarify the complete history of the Tianji Record.
choices.risk_hint: May trigger taboo topics the other party doesn't want to mention

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze如炬, he raised his hand to point at the deepest scar on the commander's brow center: "These wounds aren't simply heaven's counterattack—someone was forcibly extracting Tianji Record components from you. Cang Yutian took a portion, didn't he?"

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path commander shuddered throughout, and those浑浊的眼眸 finally rippled with waves: "You actually figured it out... Truly worthy of being chosen by the Tianji Record. Correct, he split the Tianji Record into three pieces—this is the first piece. And the piece within you—" He paused, "is the third piece."

choices.description: Make no statement, quietly wait for the other party to reveal more on their own, maintaining initiative through information asymmetry.
choices.risk_hint: The other party may therefore not say more

text.content: Chen Ji just淡淡 looked at the other party, neither nodding nor shaking his head, maintaining恰到好处的沉默. That posture resembled a fox patiently waiting for prey to make a mistake—he was gambling, betting that the other party was even more eager to achieve some purpose than he was.

dialogue.content: The silence lasted several breaths. The Demonic Path commander first打破僵局, his voice carrying a hint of helplessness: "Fine, I've waited too long and have no mood to play guessing games with you."

"I have waited in this heaven's夹缝 for ten thousand years, only to wait for one person—one who can gather the three Tianji Record fragments and reopen the path of heavenly secrets." He stepped forward, demonic qi and Heavenly Fate power interweaving and colliding, making the surrounding void hum and resound, "And you—are that person."

text.content: Chen Ji心中冷笑. Ten thousand years of waiting? Path of heavenly secrets? His expression revealed nothing, yet his mind飞速推演. The Tianji Record Fragment had never told him there was a说法 of split pieces; now this person opened his mouth with such claims, clearly well-prepared. He decided to probe one more step.

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path commander revealed an astonishing truth—Chen Ji was the key to gathering the fragments. He needed to make a final judgment.

choices.text: Temporarily playing along with 虚与委蛇
choices.description: Outwardly agree to cooperate, actually secretly remain vigilant, searching for the other party's true purpose.
choices.visible_cost: May be used by the other party
choices.risk_hint: The other party's城府 is extremely deep, may hide hidden dangers

text.content: Chen Ji沉吟片刻, raised his eyes to直视 the other party: "Cooperation is possible. But I must first know—does the 'that person' you waited for want me to accomplish something, or want me to do work for you? These are not the same thing."

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path commander沉默良久, finally letting out a long sigh: "You are indeed more cautious than Chen Xuan. Fine, I'll tell you—what I want is revenge. And what you want is to survive. We each take what we need, nothing more."

choices.description: Make clear one won't be a pawn for others, establish cooperation bottom lines before negotiating.

text.content: Chen Ji轻笑一声, his tone骤然转冷: "Ten thousand years ago Cang Yutian used you, and now someone wants to use me? Senior wouldn't think that everyone in the world would sell themselves out for a Fragment?"

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path commander was not angry at all, instead his eyes闪过一丝异彩: "Good! Good, 'sell themselves out'! Chen Xuan back then was too anxious to prove himself, which led to that outcome. You... are more worthy of commanding the Tianji Record than him."

choices.description: Neither refuse nor agree, directly propose one's own conditions as prerequisites for cooperation.

text.content: Chen Ji paced with hands behind his back, his voice unhurried: "Cooperation is possible. But I have several conditions—first, I need to know the whereabouts of the second fragment; second, you must help me solve my current troubles; third—" He paused, "Your affairs, I will not interfere with."

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path commander凝视 him for a moment, then suddenly smiled: "The second condition is easy. As for the first fragment—" He waved his hand, a black Jade Slip flew toward Chen Ji, "This is all the clues I've collected over ten thousand years. Is that enough sincerity?"

text.content: The moment the Jade Slip entered his hand, Chen Ji's brow center jerked violently—the aura emanating from the Jade Slip actually resonated with the seal within him that even he didn't know about. He forcefully suppressed the惊涛骇浪 in his heart, his expression如常 as he stored the Jade Slip in his sleeve. Just then, the Demonic Path commander suddenly spoke, his voice carrying a meaning深长的笑意: "By the way, I almost forgot one thing—"

He stepped forward, those浑浊的眼眸 seemingly able to see through all illusions, staring直直 at Chen Ji's brow center: "Why do you think your parents died seventeen years ago? Why do you think your sister was taken by the Holy Sect?" He paused, his voice deep as an ancient bell, "That is because—apart from the Tianji Record Fragment, another 重命运印记 slumbers within you. That is what heaven truly wants to erase. And your sister Chen Nian is... the lock key for that印记."
